title: Electro/photo multi-energy triggered expanded graphite/polyethylene glycol composite phase change materials for wearable thermotherapy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29800-29810
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04061B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bui Van Phuoc, Ho Phuong, Le Thi Duy Hanh, Huynh Nguyen Anh Tuan, Minh Tam Le, Nguyen Ngoc Que Anh, Luong Thi Thao, Giang Tien Nguyen
An eye-patch produced from PEG/ExG composite shows a high heat storage capacity. It can be effectively charged by both photothermal and electrothermal conversion effects and shows qualified performance in thermotherapy.
